messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: v2.4.0
parts:
I think almost all the pull requests that need to go in are in.

I'm testing the one that will fix some of RStan's performance issues now. Jenkins is still not automated, so I'm kicking things off by hand.

I'm giving the Stan talk at ISBA tomorrow morning and finalizing the talk tonight. I can update the versions and get everything packaged up for Stan's tagging by Wednesday.

CmdStan should be ready to go either Wednesday evening or Thursday.

Bob, can I leave the release notes and updating the website to you? Regarding pushing to the server, I don't have Jenkins configured yet -- could we push by hand for this release?




Daniel
